caseNameFull: J. W. Selsor v. State of Louisiana
summary: Error to the Supreme Court of the. State of Louisiana.
attorneys: Mr. J. D. Wilkinson, Mr. A. L. Alexander and Mr. T. Alexander for plaintiff in error. No brief filed for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of (1) Act of March 1, 1913, c. 90, 37 Stat. 699. (2) Seaboard Air Line Ry. v. North Carolina, 245 U. S. 298, 303; Clark Distilling Co. v. Western Maryland Ry. Co., 242 U. S. 311, 325.
